transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, October 23. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Will decide on any notice to remove CEC according to rules: LS Speaker Om Birla. Both the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha chairman had rejected previous notices from the opposition, saying their allegations "do not prima facie meet the high constitutional bar for removal proceedings". Birla noted the process for removal of the chief election commissioner was the same as for removing a Supreme Court judge. PHP security flaws trigger global scramble; CERT-In flags vulnerabilities. Google Cloud executives Chris Betz, chief information security officer, and Raluca Ada Popa, head of Gemini Security at Google DeepMind, said PHP and cybersecurity firm Wiz Research disclosed the two vulnerabilities after research that used multiple AI models to identify and help remediate them. Google Cloud said its own infrastructure was not vulnerable, but warned that customers running PHP applications on the platform could be exposed Hospitals 'overcharging' is a malpractice: Government to Supreme Court. In an affidavit filed in SC on the issue of capping prices of all medicines and medical consumables, chemicals and fertilisers ministry said that patients have a very low bargaining position with respect to hospitals, resulting in various malpractices. The affidavit noted the irony of India being home to companies making cheap drugs but patients here having to pay way above the manufacturing price, as well as patients being subjected to overcharging by hospitals. 16 killed, 32 injured in magnitude 7 earthquake in Tibet; rescue ops under way. Police and fire department personnel have been working to rescue people and provide temporary shelter to those who had lost their homes. Rescue teams were also putting up tents to accommodate residents displaced by the earthquake. According to the United States Geological Survey (USGS), the earthquake occurred at 10.33 pm local time. Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk. Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed. After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean. President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users. Georgia woman loses marijuana smoke case as court upholds pension fund immunity. A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour's marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers' pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit. Will back all meaningful efforts for Ukraine peace, PM Modi assures Poland's Tusk. PM Modi and his Polish counterpart Tusk expressed deepest concern in a joint statement over the war in Ukraine, including its tragic humanitarian consequences and the impact on Global South. In his media statement, Modi assured Tusk that whether it is Ukraine or West Asia, India will continue to support every meaningful effort for peace. Congress defaming India to shield Nehru-Gandhi family: PM Modi. "Dimagi naxals have captured Congress so much that it has lost its ability to think. Those who used to cause destruction in forests are now determined to wreak havoc on the country through Congress," PM Modi said, referring to hardcore Left elements accused of being sympathetic to Maoists and now vocal in protests against EC and govt. Retired decorator's £300 Pokemon cards sell for £1.56M after 15 years. A retired decorator has become an overnight millionaire after his Pokemon card collection, stored in his attic for 15 years, fetched £1.56 million at auction. The collector, who bought complete sets for as little as £300, discovered their value after reading a newspaper report. A rare Charizard set alone achieved a hammer price of £100,000. Zuckerberg weighed selling $110M home over billionaire tax, struck Meta deal. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg reportedly considered selling his $110 million Palo Alto home and leaving California over a proposed 5 percent wealth tax on billionaires. He has struck an eight-year deal with Meta to remain in California or where the company is headquartered. The agreement provides non-voting shares to help cover a potential multibillion-dollar tax bill while protecting his voting control.
